thematic_clusters.theme: Shell-string injection of model/prompt/agent text into store_learning.py (the junk-creator + cross-model-blind class)
thematic_clusters.root: Multiple hooks build store_learning.py commands by string-interpolating untrusted text into execSync on Windows cmd.exe with bash-only escaping (quote/newline) — un-escaped & | < > ^ % backtick break quoting and redirect stdout into junk files (opc/400`); content starting 'Agent ' is also a NOISE_PREFIX so the store is gate-rejected after the damage. Fix: argv-array spawn (no shell) or stdin-fed payloads across all callers.

thematic_clusters.theme: Grep-pattern shell injection in the search-router path
thematic_clusters.root: smart-search-router + daemon-client feed the model-controlled raw Grep pattern into execSync cmd.exe strings (and a double-shelled PowerShell->cmd path), escaping only " and $ so the cmd.exe danger set survives; the same hook writes a handshake to hardcoded POSIX /tmp (lands at C:\tmp, unbounded since January), hard-denies legitimate 3+-word searches, and recommends the banned Explore spawn — which hook-auto-execute.md tells Claude to run unprompted. Fix: argv-array rg invocation, OS-temp path, drop the deny-Explore advice.

thematic_clusters.theme: ROADMAP cross-project contamination + unguarded post-commit write race
thematic_clusters.root: The post-plan contamination guard is a negative allowlist of REGISTERED sibling projects (unregistered foreign work is invisible, and the 'claude' identity keyword can't protect a project named continuous-claude); plan selection reads newest-mtime from the machine-global ~/.claude/plans pool; buildUnifiedContext re-extracts Current Focus bypassing the guard; prd-roadmap-sync/git-commit-roadmap mark the current goal complete on any checked tasks file or foreign-repo commit; and on a single hook-edit commit three unguarded write-side actors (forward-sync, roadmap RMW, arch-stats detached writer) race the same files. Fix: positive project-identity match via path.relative containment + event-own-plan selection + write ordering.

thematic_clusters.theme: Memory recall floor + intent pollution (the 27.4% hit-rate failure)
thematic_clusters.root: Two co-dominant causes: (1) intent pollution — no UserPromptSubmit filter strips synthetic <task-notification> XML before it becomes the recall/bus intent (24.6%), extractIntent/expandGitQuery have no machine-content guard and substring-match 'pr'/'commit', and the agent injector passes the whole multi-KB prompt (0-for-78); (2) the math floor — HYBRID_FLOOR 0.01 on decay-multiplied RRF and a plainto_tsquery AND-FTS arm exclude most of the corpus, capping best-case ~36% even after the pollution fix. 100% of recall benefit accrues to 'main' (zero sub-agent rows), so the agent layer is memory-blind. Fix: synthetic-prompt filter + length cap, re-tune floor/FTS, route recall to sub-agents.

thematic_clusters.theme: UserPromptSubmit / SessionStart hot-path latency (uv cold-start tax)
thematic_clusters.root: The prompt hot path serializes 13 process spawns (~22-32s worst case); memory recall alone pays two cold `uv run python` boots (~2.2s each) per prompt with a falsely-'parallel' docstring and no result cache, while the BGE daemon amortizes only the embedding model, not the interpreter; SessionStart fans out 8 hooks (~105s ceiling) with no-timeout docker probes and a 300s tree-staleness window that regenerates almost every open. Fix: a resident recall daemon (reuse the embedding_daemon.py TCP-rendezvous), genuine parallelism, prompt cache, and timeout caps.

thematic_clusters.theme: Settings drift: active-only registrations vs repo/template (new-machine safety gap)
thematic_clusters.root: 18 hook registrations live in active but are absent from tracked repo settings — including the supply-chain guard package-install-guard and the permission-system defeat permission-auto-allow — while the bootstrap template still registers the mitigated navigator-safety; package-install-guard is also start-anchored so compound commands bypass it, and 9 git-tracked Python hooks (incl braintrust_hooks.py, live on 5 events) were never inventoried. A machine bootstrapped from the repo lacks the supply-chain guard yet ships a safety-inverting hook. Fix: reconcile all three settings surfaces to one source of truth and fix the guard anchoring.

permission-auto-allow auto-approves every PermissionRequest except AskUserQuestion/ExitPlanMode, nullifying the OS permission layer system-wide in normal mode; navigator-safety auto-approved destructive Bash (mitigated, source needs allow->ask rewrite); the plan-mode gate downgrades deny->ask under --dangerously-skip-permissions on transcript-resolution failure; isRalphActive() has no TTL so a stale state file permanently disables both plan gates; and package-install-guard is bypassed by compound commands. Fix: scope the auto-allow allowlist, add TTL to ralph-active, fail-closed on transcript failure.

thematic_clusters.theme: Codegraph facade latency + unmeasurable telemetry (adoption-gate risk)
thematic_clusters.root: Live codegraph queries run 16-88s (median ~62s, 10x the documented 3-4s) because ensureFresh spawns one full process per dirty file on every call with no source filter; the facade's telemetry is unjoinable (bus_id 'unknown' on 35/37 rows, agent never set, correlation_id a fresh per-call randomUUID -> corr-null 60.7%, 0/125 ids chain), so the §9 facade-vs-bypass denominator has zero data and in-facade routing sits at 45.7% against the >=80% C.5 gate. Two cross-cutting amplifiers worth banking early because they are quick-wins that unblock multiple clusters: re-keying Agent->Task matchers (D2b-01 cluster) revives ~12 dead hooks at once, and the settings-drift reconciliation (SEED-15 cluster) closes the new-machine supply-chain hole. elegance.verdict_rationale: CCv3's core substrate is genuinely sound — the D5b verification manifest cleared the SQL layer, secret handling, path-traversal defenses, and the L3 boundary/bus design as well-built — but the enforcement and intelligence PERIPHERY is largely dead or mis-wired, which is the signature of accreted baroque growth, not elegance. The hard numbers: of 111 hook srcs only 76 register (35 never fire); 30 of 36 agents have never hit the recall surface; memory recall misses 72.6% of prompts (27.4% hit) with 24.6% intent-pollution; 28 ghost skill registrations route to skills that do not exist; the ENTIRE agent safety+verification chain (D2b-01/D10c-02) plus Maestro gating (D8a-01) fire under matcher "Agent" while the live tool emits "Task", so they never run despite RULES.md asserting C:10 blocking guarantees. The system is neither "elegantly working" (too much of its claimed machinery is inert and three doc surfaces assert enforcement that never fires) nor purely baroque (the load-bearing core — memory store/recall math aside — is clean and the duplication is consolidatable, not fundamental). It is mixed: a clean spine wrapped in a thick layer of dead hooks, never-recalled agents, ghost skills, triplicated scripts, and 7 competing session-id schemes that should be pruned to expose the elegant core that already exists.
